35: class EntityRegistry(Flow360BaseModel):
36:     """
37:     A registry for managing and storing instances of various entity types.
38: 
39:     This class provides methods to register entities, retrieve entities by their type,
40:     and find entities by name patterns using regular expressions.
41: 
42:     Attributes:
43:         internal_registry (Dict[str, List[EntityBase]]): A dictionary that maps entity types to lists of instances.
44: 
45:     #Known Issues:
46:     frozen=True do not stop the user from changing the internal_registry
47:     """
48: 
49:     internal_registry: Dict[str, list[Any]] = pd.Field({})
50: 
51:     def register(self, entity: EntityBase):
52:         """
53:         Registers an entity in the registry under its type.
54: 
55:         Parameters:
56:             entity (EntityBase): The entity instance to register.
57:         """
58:         # pylint: disable=unsupported-membership-test
59:         if entity.entity_bucket not in self.internal_registry:
60:             # pylint: disable=unsupported-assignment-operation
61:             self.internal_registry[entity.entity_bucket] = []
62: 
63:         # pylint: disable=unsubscriptable-object
64:         for existing_entity in self.internal_registry[entity.entity_bucket]:
65:             if existing_entity.name == entity.name:
66:                 # Same type and same name. Now we try to update existing entity with new values.
67:                 try:
68:                     existing_entity = _merge_objects(existing_entity, entity)
69:                     return
70:                 except MergeConflictError as e:
71:                     raise MergeConflictError(
72:                         f"Entity with name '{entity.name}' and type '{entity.entity_bucket}' "
73:                         "already exists and have different definition."
74:                     ) from e
75:                 except Exception as e:
76:                     log.debug("Merge failed unexpectly: %s", e)
77:                     raise
78:         # pylint: disable=unsubscriptable-object
79:         self.internal_registry[entity.entity_bucket].append(entity)
80: 
81:     def get_bucket(self, by_type: EntityBase) -> EntityRegistryBucket:
82:         """Get the bucket of a certain type of entity."""
83:         return EntityRegistryBucket(
84:             self.internal_registry,
85:             by_type.model_fields["private_attribute_registry_bucket_name"].default,
86:         )
87: 
88:     def find_by_type(self, entity_class: type[EntityBase]) -> list[EntityBase]:
89:         """
90:         Finds all registered entities of a given type.
91:         """
92:         matched_entities = []
93:         # pylint: disable=no-member
94:         for entity_list in self.internal_registry.values():
95:             matched_entities.extend(filter(lambda x: isinstance(x, entity_class), entity_list))
96: 
97:         return matched_entities
98: 
99:     def find_by_naming_pattern(
100:         self, pattern: str, enforce_output_as_list: bool = True, error_when_no_match: bool = False
101:     ) -> list[EntityBase]:
102:         """
103:         Finds all registered entities whose names match a given pattern.
104: 
105:         Parameters:
106:             pattern (str): A naming pattern, which can include '*' as a wildcard.
107: 
108:         Returns:
109:             List[EntityBase]: A list of entities whose names match the pattern.
110:         """
111:         matched_entities = []
112:         if "*" in pattern:
113:             regex_pattern = pattern.replace("*", ".*")
114:         else:
115:             regex_pattern = f"^{pattern}$"  # Exact match if no '*'
116: 
117:         regex = re.compile(regex_pattern)
118:         # pylint: disable=no-member
119:         for entity_list in self.internal_registry.values():
120:             matched_entities.extend(filter(lambda x: regex.match(x.name), entity_list))
121: 
122:         if not matched_entities and error_when_no_match is True:
123:             raise ValueError(
124:                 f"No entity found in registry with given name/naming pattern: '{pattern}'."
125:             )
126:         if enforce_output_as_list is False and len(matched_entities) == 1:
127:             return matched_entities[0]
128: 
129:         return matched_entities
130: 
131:     def find_single_entity_by_name(self, name: str):
132:         """Retrieve the entity with the given name from the registry."""
133:         entities = self.find_by_naming_pattern(
134:             name, enforce_output_as_list=True, error_when_no_match=True
135:         )
136:         if len(entities) > 1:
137:             raise ValueError(f"Multiple entities found in registry with given name: '{name}'.")
138:         return entities[0]
139: 
140:     def __str__(self):
141:         """
142:         Returns a string representation of all registered entities, grouped by type.
143:         """
144:         index = 0
145:         result = "---- Content of the registry ----\n"
146:         # pylint: disable=no-member
147:         for entity_bucket, entities in self.internal_registry.items():
148:             result += f"    Entities of type '{entity_bucket}':\n"
149:             for entity in entities:
150:                 result += f"    - [{index:03d}]\n{entity}\n"
151:                 index += 1
152:         result += "---- End of content ----"
153:         return result
154: 
155:     def clear(self, entity_type: Union[None, type[EntityBase]] = None):
156:         """
157:         Clears all entities from the registry.
158:         """
159:         # pylint: disable=no-member
160:         if entity_type is not None:
161:             bucket_name = entity_type.model_fields["private_attribute_registry_bucket_name"].default
162:             if bucket_name in self.internal_registry.keys():
163:                 # pylint: disable=unsubscriptable-object
164:                 self.internal_registry[bucket_name].clear()
165:         else:
166:             self.internal_registry.clear()
167: 
168:     def contains(self, entity: EntityBase) -> bool:
169:         """
170:         Returns True if the registry contains any entities, False otherwise.
171:         """
172:         # pylint: disable=unsupported-membership-test
173:         if entity.entity_bucket in self.internal_registry:
174:             # pylint: disable=unsubscriptable-object
175:             if entity in self.internal_registry[entity.entity_bucket]:
176:                 return True
177:         return False
178: 
179:     def entity_count(self) -> int:
180:         """Return total number of entities in the registry."""
181:         count = 0
182:         # pylint: disable=no-member
183:         for list_of_entities in self.internal_registry.values():
184:             count += len(list_of_entities)
185:         return count
186: 
187:     def replace_existing_with(self, new_entity: EntityBase):
188:         """
189:         Replaces an entity in the registry with a new entity.
190: 
191:         Parameters:
192:             new_entity (EntityBase): The new entity to replace the existing entity with.
193:         """
194:         bucket_to_find = new_entity.entity_bucket
195:         # pylint: disable=unsupported-membership-test
196:         if bucket_to_find not in self.internal_registry:
197:             return
198: 
199:         # pylint: disable=unsubscriptable-object
200:         for entity in self.internal_registry[bucket_to_find]:
201:             if entity.name == new_entity.name:
202:                 self.internal_registry[bucket_to_find].remove(entity)
203:                 self.internal_registry[bucket_to_find].append(new_entity)
204:                 return
205: 
206:         self.register(new_entity)
207: 
208:     @property
209:     def is_empty(self):
210:         """Return True if the registry is empty, False otherwise."""
211:         return not self.internal_registry
